notes.title: Attack on Hex Island is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Attack on Hex Island 1.0[/h1]

[*] Sail across the 7 regions engaging in token battles to save its inhabitants
[*] Collect, evolve, customize, and upgrade your tokens to build the ultimate deck
[*] Battle online against your friends to strengthen your abilities and prove your are the best

notes.title: Endless Mode Added
notes.content:
[h1]New Mode[/h1]
After finishing the game you will unlock a new "Endless Mode", accessible from the boat, where you will fight against Rogue in consecutive matches where her hand is randomized each time and looting is disabled. Here's the catch! You have to choose 6 tokens and stick with them until the end. 

Put together your best team and see how many matches you can win. Your highest consecutive wins are submitted to the leaderboards.

Have fun! 

[h1]Fixes / Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Adds region intro animations
[*] Adds Inventory menu to the boat
[*] Adds island progression to the profiles on the main menu
[*] Fixes incorrect ally attack boost calculations 
[*] Fixes ignited bombs turning themselves off before exploding
[*] Updates the intro cutscene to better convey the overall story
[/list]

notes.title: Online PvP Matches 2.0
notes.content:
[h1]Updates[/h1]

[list]
[*] Adds the option to disable "hints" before entering a battle.
[*] Final boss has been updated to create a more unique and fun challenge.
[*] The Online PvP Matches has been redesigned with the following new features:
    [list]
        [*] Adds a "?" (random) option for each board configuration.
        [*] Adds a "skip looting" option when looting is enabled to show mercy to your opponent.
        [*] Adds Emojis to let your opponent know how you feel during a match.
        [*] Adds a turn timer (2 minutes) per turn that will automatically forfeit a match if the timer runs out. 
        [*] Adds a looting timer that will automatically skip looting if the timer runs out.
        [*] Adds notification to indicate when someone has join or left the game .
        [*] Adds notification to indicate when the opponent is ready to battle.
        [*] Adds the ability to join an online match from the Level Select.
    [/list]
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixes graphical artifacts showing when opening a chest.
[*] Fixes PvP players remaining in the lobby after disconnecting.
[*] Fixes the re-roll ability rolling when it had not rolled a lower number.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v2.5.5
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Cards not being selectable after paginating while the cursor was on them
[*] Cards become not focused when changing pages even when the cursor was on them
[*] Shield ability not playing when blocking a token
[*] Shield ability playing when the card is captured
[*] Tinker percentage not resetting when removing the token being tinkered

[/list]

notes.title: Online PvP Matches
notes.content:
[h1]What's New[/h1]
Online PvP Matches are now available allowing you to battle your friends in either friendly exhibition matches or test your friendship and loot their tokens!

In this current version of PvP Matches, you will only be able to battle against someone on your friend's list. We do plan to open it up to anyone hosting a match but want to have room to test, fix, and tweak Online Battles before we open it up. 

To access PvP matches, just go into the Boat and talk to the new NPC waiting for you there. From there, you will be able to HOST or Join a game a friend is hosting. Have Fun!

[h1]Fixes / Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixes filters not resetting when the inventory is closed making it looked as if they were "active" when they were not
[*] Fixes filters no updating the total available token pages
[*] Fixes tokens in the tinkering panel not being swappable by clicking on them
[*] Fixes the "Remove" button in the tinker panel not disabling itself when dragging a token
[*] Fixes tokens that were "focused" when the inventory closes become "focused" again when the menu is re-opened and the cursor is not on that token.
[/list]

[h1]What Next?[/h1]
We are working on getting the game ready to release the 1.0 version, so be on the lookout for that announcement.

notes.title: Version 2.5.3 is out now!
notes.content:
[h1]What's New or Updated?[/h1]
[list]
[*] Adds unique sounds for each critter
[*] Adds using ESC to close out of menus
[*] Adds the use of the back button to discard a token
[*] Removes the intro dialogue when replaying the tutorial match
[*] Adds the use of the back button to return to the island from the store
[*] Adds a "remove" button in the Tinkerer to clear the tokens being used for tinkering

[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixes localization typos
[*] Fixes starter pack not properly shuffling arrow distribution
[*] Fixes the "total play time" not displaying correctly after 24 hours of gameplay

[/list]

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
We are working on the finishing touches for the first iteration of PvP Battle! 
This is scheduled to be released by end of June 2024.

notes.title: Version 2.5.2
notes.content:
[h1]What's new?[/h1]
[list]
[*] We've added windowed mode!
[*] Additional NPC/Token rebalancing
[*] The names of the regions are now visible
[*] Relabeled "Beta" in main menu to "Early Access"
[*] We changed the shop song to avoid twitch triggering copyright infringements
[*] A region will now be marked as perfect if all NPCs on that region have been perfected
[/list]

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
We are actively working on PvP, only taking breaks to address bugs/improvements as new players communicate the issues. We will be adding PvP to early access as soon as it is available as we would love the help from the community to vet out any issues we might have overlooked.

We are also talking about what a "roguelike" mode would like as post-game content. 
Thanks again to all who have purchased the game, reviewed it, and have provide us with feedback to improve the game. [url=https://discord.gg/xWxN6CVTbP]Discord[/url] is always the best place for your feedback to be heard and we would love for you to stop by and let us know how we can continue to make this game even better for you.

Sincerely,
Attack on Hex Island Development Team

notes.title: Version 2.5.0
notes.content:
Fixes & Updates:
[olist]
[*] Adds display settings which allows you to change resolution and enable/disable borderless mode
[*] Adds a failsafe to prevent the screen to stay black after a cutscene is done
[*] Adds a notification icon when there's something new in the boat
[*] Adds a more accessible way to exit the ship

notes.title: Final Region Is Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]What's New[/h1]
The final region has been added and with it the completed story and full single player experience with all unlockables. We are still in Early Access as we iron out/polish all the content and work out the features for the final release.

Reminder, if you are an early access adopter, in addition to getting to play the full game early, you get a 25% off the full release price. :D 

[h1]Fixes & Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved AI 
[*] Booster packs are unlocked sooner
[*] Winning against a defeated opponent awards you with higher amount of money
[*] Rebalanced Tinkering success rate
[*] Added Additional achievements
[*] Fixed UI to fit in both a 16:9 and a 16:10 aspect ratio
[*] Fixed save file progression tracking
[/list]

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
In preparations to get the game ready for final release, aside from bug fixes to the early access version, we aim to make our next major update be the final game, so be on the look out for the release date announcement. 

We are working on PvP, additional language support (Spanish/Japanese), and display settings (window mode), until tell, come join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/FxWxN6CVTbP]discord[/url] and tell us what you like about the game and how we can improve it. Also, be sure to leave us a review on steam to help others who might be unsure if they would like the game. 

Thanks again for all of your support and we look forward to finishing this game and making it the best it can be for your enjoyment. :D

notes.title: Bug Fixed: NPC Progression Lost
notes.content:
We discovered a bug that caused defeated npcs to be marked as not defeated if the game was exited by going to the title screen and clicking on the Exit button. This bug has been corrected and NPCs progression is no longer reset.

Your tokens, coins, booster packs, tinkers, and unlocked regions are all still saved, only the NPCs were being marked as not defeated. If you are affected by this bug, please DMs us in [url=https://discord.gg/xWxN6CVTbP]discord[/url] and we will do our best to help you.

Thank you and we sincerely apologize for this inconvenience.

notes.title: Swamp Region Added
notes.content:
[h1]What's New?[/h1]
The penultimate region has been added bringing with it the most untrustworthy characters you will ever find. In this poisonous swamp the very passion that once drove the inhabitants have poisoned their minds to the point that nothing that they say can be trusted. Still, at their core, their souls can be saved.

Are you skilled enough to not be affected by the their toxic behavior or will you too be consumed by the Swamp?

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated character selection
[*] Added ambience sound effects 
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Starter pack not having arrows for all directions
[/list]

notes.title: Tundra Region Is Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]What's New?[/h1]
Join our brave messenger as they travel to the coldest region in all of Hex Island, the Tundra Region. What was once a paradise filled with beautiful meadows, flowing rivers, and warming hot springs has now been become a desolate ice-land where the only ones living there are those who wish to be left alone and perhaps welcome the impending doom.

Are you skilled enough to break through their cold-as-ice hearts and restore in them the hope they once had, or will they finally meet the end they so eagerly await?

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] New element
[*] New token lines
[*] New token abilities
[*] New achievements
[*] New board obstacle
[*] New random event for matches
[/list]
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Token info shows trumping information
[*] Guidebook saves the last page you were on
[*] Ability to discard a single token vs the entire hand
[*] Redesigned the dice roll system to create a more predictable outcome
[*] Board generations was updated to build more meaningful and fun layouts to play on
[*] Pressing back while on the settings returns you to your last menu if one was opened
[*] Overall progression scaling has been tweaked to support a more gradual scale in difficulty 
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Save icon would get stuck animating 
[*] Token animations not properly resetting 
[*] Level paths not always drawing correctly
[*] Level being interactable during cutscenes
[*] Battle based achievements not being triggered
[*] Bosses were not getting saved as being defeated
[*] NPC Token clipping when being revealed during battle
[*] Locked levels could trigger the mouse over/exit effects
[*] Flashback effect still visible when settings menu is opened in a flashback cutscene
[*] Card portraits in battle not activating if your cursor was on the card before your turn 
[*] Hexdex not properly resetting cells keeping them marked as selected after menu closed
[/list]

notes.title: Missing Saved Data Fixed!
notes.content: We apologize for those of you who lost your save file upon getting the latest update. This was due to how profiles were getting saved which conflicted with how updates work. We have corrected this bug and now your save files will persist per run and updates. Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: Removes Tests Save Files
notes.content:
We forgot to remove the tests files we used to confirm the game is in working condition. This caused new downloads to have already saved data. We removed these. 

For those who already received the game with the test safe files, feel free to override them with your own new profile. :D

notes.title: Coming Soon
notes.content:
[h2]What's going on?[/h2]
Originally, we planned to release the game in December of 2023, but this was changed because life happens and personal matters took us away from working on the game. By God's grace, it was a minor speed bump and we are now back to full-time development. We're aiming for a release in [b]early March of 2024.[/b] 

[h2]So what now?[/h2]
Don't fret, we won't leave you empty handed! You can expect a [b]new demo[/b] to release this coming Friday, January 5th 2024. The upcoming demo will have a re-designed beach region, new characters, and  other new surprises, so keep an eye out! We are also working with valve to make the game be available for early access and will let you know when valve allows us to do so.

Thank you for wishlisting the game, playing the demo, and for looking forward to when the game releases. We are working very hard to make this game a fun and enjoyable experience, and we appreciate your patience.
